title: Sound
bassHint: Boosts low frequencies for a fuller, warmer sound.
exciterHint: Regenerates upper harmonics, similar to high-frequency restoration on music players. Does not turn compressed audio into lossless.
crossfeedHint: Subtly blends both channels like speakers to reduce listening fatigue.
widthHint: Narrows or widens the left/right stereo stage.
limiterHint: Keeps peaks in check to prevent distortion when boosting EQ or bass.
note: Applies to this device only. Requires Simple mode to be off (Settings → Playback).
settingsHint: Equalizer, bass boost, exciter, headphone crossfeed. Saved for this device.
